assembly_summary: Original face, muzzle, eye ticks and ear strokes are keyed to the cow turning toward camera and chewing. The source close-up crops most of the full-body doodle; its body parts remain in the editable cast. The sky and distant horizon are drawn once.
review_note: Independent still identity/source-event and normal-speed playback review pending.
